additional_info.body:
Good evening colleagues,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0391607
for charger
zaBsY8.
The ticket was opened for issues on the Valina Payment Terminal. From the video attached in the ticket, you can see how the payment terminal keeps rebooting. From a charger point of view, the only symptom is the error flag:
PaymentTerminalUnreachable_PZx
sicharge-cp
CONNECTION
true
Connection to terminal failed with error: Communication failure.
I connected via SSH to the charger and this is the outcome:
It clearly seems that the terminal is reachable but every few minutes the communication is interrupted, which matches with the boot loop of the terminal.
Furthermore, I had a check at the logs and the behavior of the terminal is completely different from the symptoms appearing with the known issue of Valina terminals logged out.
Therefore, I would highly recommend to replace this payment terminal. I cannot say why the terminal suddenly stopped working though. I would recommend to get in touch with QM and ship this terminal back to the factory for further analysis.
Since an onsite visit and replacement is required to proceed, I will move this ticket
ID0391607
from the
eMobility HQ DC Charger Queue (Level 3)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2).
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2).
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
Team, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to me.
